svg.text: ** Dimension of field installation of signs or markings may
exceed the figures in the table by up to 100 feet per
work order or plan in order to adjust to field conditions.
C= Advance warning sign placement (CA MUTCD,
This standard plan applies to new installations and reinstallations of marked
crosswalks and to marked crosswalks determined to be retained as a result
of a study on multi-lane facilities. Use of signs shall be in coordination with all
other controls shown on this plan.
Crosswalk Sign Assembly signs shall be posted and should be positioned
within ten feet of the crosswalk. These signs generally shall be posted
back-to-back so that one sign is on the right and the other on the left. If a
raised median with a width 6' or greater exists, the left sign shall be in the
median. These signs should be 36" X 36". The W16-9p or W16-7p plates shall
be 36" wide. All signs shall be fluorescent yellow-green.
Advance Pedestrian Crossing W11-15, W11-2 signs, or Assembly D (CA) signs shall
be posted as shown and shall be fluorescent yellow-green. R1-5 signs shall be
posted and positioned within ten feet of the yield limit line. These locations may be
adjusted to accommodate field conditions. All signs should be 36" X 36".
"PED XING" or "SCHOOL XING" pavement markings shall be installed as shown
except the yellow "SLOW SCHOOL XING" pavement markings shall be installed in
advance of uncontrolled yellow school crosswalks. If the crosswalk spacing is less
than 500 feet, only one set of pavement markings is required in advance of the first
This standard plan also applies at uncontrolled approaches to midblock crosswalks.
Install RPMs one each side of crosswalk bar facing approach
lanes. Two-way clear (white) or two-way amber (yellow) per
CALTRANS standards and specifications may be installed
R1-5 (YIELD HERE TO PEDESTRIANS) SIGNS AND YIELD LINES
For uncontrolled locations with more than one lane in each
direction of travel, advance yield lines may be used. Yield lines
shall be supplemented with R1-5 signs.
